profile.recovery_codes_description: Save these recovery codes in a secure place. You can use them to access your account if you lose your authenticator device.
profile.recovery_codes_one_time_info: Recovery codes are only shown once after generation. If you lost them, you can generate new codes below.

profile.export_error: An error occurred while exporting data
profile.import_all_data_description: Import all your data including task lists, tasks, and subtasks from a backup file exported from this application.
profile.import_data_description: Import your data from a backup file.
profile.import_from_file_description: Import your data from a JSON file exported from this application.
profile.select_file_import_all: Select File to Import All Data
profile.import_error: An error occurred while importing data
profile.import_note_1: New items will be added. Existing items (matched by ID) will be updated only if the imported version is newer.
profile.import_note_2: Items are identified by their unique IDs. Ensure IDs match if you intend to update existing data.
profile.import_note_3: Tasks must belong to a valid list ID present in the import file or already existing in your data.
profile.import_note_4: For best results, import data that was exported from this application.
profile.import_note_5: If importing 'decrypted' data, it will be encrypted with your current key. 'Encrypted' data is imported as is.

notification_error.unknown_error: An unknown error occurred while changing notification settings.

notification_sync_error.title: Couldn't sync your reminder schedule with the server
notification_sync_error.help: Your notification times haven't been registered. Reload the page or toggle notifications off and on to retry. Reminders may not fire until the schedule syncs.

notification_lead.label: Remind me about tasks with a time
notification_lead.help: When to fire a notification for a task that has a specific time set.

notification_all_day_time.label: Reminder time for date-only tasks
notification_all_day_time.help: You'll get a notification at this time on the day a task without a specific time is due. Snaps to 5-minute marks.

notification_background_delivery.label: Background notifications (server-assisted)
notification_background_delivery.help: When on, notifications fire even with the app closed. The server learns when (rounded to 5 minutes) a reminder is due, but never sees the task title or body - those are decrypted locally on your device. Turn off if you prefer the server to know nothing about reminder timing; notifications will then only fire while the app is open.

notifications_macos_info: On macOS, also check System Settings → Notifications → your browser and make sure notifications are allowed.

backup_codes.title: Backup Codes
backup_codes.info: Backup codes are one-time passwords that allow you to access your account when other authentication methods are unavailable. In Zero-Knowledge architecture, they are the only way to recover your account.
backup_codes.regenerate_warning: Generating new codes will invalidate all existing codes. Are you sure you want to continue?
backup_codes.status_not_generated: Backup codes have not been generated yet
backup_codes.status_all_used: All codes have been used. Generate new ones.

backup_codes.one_time_warning: These codes are shown only once. Store them in a secure location.
backup_codes.setup_description: These codes will help you access your account if you lose your authenticator device. Each code can be used only once.
backup_codes.generate_failed_warning: Recovery codes could not be generated automatically. You can generate them later in Security settings.

import_export.export_encrypted_description: Download an encrypted copy of your data. Requires the same master key to read.
import_export.export_portable_description: Protected with your own password - can be imported on any account.

import_export.portable_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
import_export.import_encrypted_prompt: This backup is password-protected. Enter the password used during export:

import_export.import_note_1: New items will be added; existing ones updated only if the imported version is newer.
import_export.import_note_2: Decrypted data will be re-encrypted with your current key on import.
import_export.import_note_3: For best results, import files exported from this application.

delete_account.title: Delete Account
delete_account.description: Permanently delete your account and all data
delete_account.warning_description: Deleting your account permanently removes all your data — lists, tasks, subtasks, recovery codes, and sessions. In Zero Knowledge architecture, data is encrypted with your key and cannot be recovered after account deletion.
delete_account.error_generic: Error deleting account. Please try again.
